result.instructions: Tools for Stay AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscribers have failed payments right now and how many retries are left?"; "List every subscription that was cancelled in the last 30 days, with the reasons given."; "Show the billing attempts that failed with a card decline this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stay AI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stayai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stayai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stayai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. stayai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stayai_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscription contracts with status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED), next billing date, customer and dunning state. Good first call for churn and billing questions. Stay API: GET /subscriptions/.

is_in_dunning.description: Only subscriptions with failed payments being retried.

created_at_min.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

created_at_max.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

updated_at_min.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

updated_at_max.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

next_billing_date_min.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

next_billing_date_max.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, as the Stay docs name it.

tools.name: stayai_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by its Shopify or internal subscription id. Stay API: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: stayai_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List subscription customers, filtered by creation or update time. Stay API: GET /customers.

tools.name: stayai_list_orders
tools.title: List subscription orders
tools.description: List recurring orders generated from subscriptions, filtered by creation or update time. Stay API: GET /orders.

created_at_min.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

created_at_max.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

updated_at_min.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

updated_at_max.description: Timestamp filter as an integer, in the format the Stay docs use.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, as the Stay docs name it (e.g. createdAt).

tools.name: stayai_list_billing_attempts
tools.title: List billing attempts
tools.description: List billing attempts for the store, successful and failed, with error codes and messages. Useful for payment-failure and dunning analysis. Stay API: GET /billing/attempts.

subscription_id.description: Only attempts for this subscription id.

customer_email.description: Only attempts for this customer email.

billing_attempt_date_min.description: Lower bound of the attempt date, as the Stay docs format it.

billing_attempt_date_max.description: Upper bound of the attempt date, as the Stay docs format it.

tools.name: stayai_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog products
tools.description: List the products in the store catalog that Stay can sell on subscription. Stay API: GET /products/catalog.

tools.name: stayai_get_catalog_product
tools.title: Get a catalog product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by its Shopify product id. Stay API: GET /products/{shopifyProductId}.

shopify_product_id.description: Shopify product id (gid://shopify/Product/... or the numeric id).

tools.name: stayai_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.title: List selling plan groups
tools.description: List subscription selling plan groups (the plans a shopper can pick), optionally for one product or variant. Stay API: GET /selling-plan-groups/.

tools.name: stayai_get_selling_plan_group
tools.title: Get a selling plan group
tools.description: Get one selling plan group by its Stay id. Stay API: GET /selling-plan-groups/{sellingPlanGroupId}.

selling_plan_group_id.description: The Stay selling plan group id (from stayai_list_selling_plan_groups).

tools.name: stayai_end_subscription
tools.title: End a Stay subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription. This ends future orders and cannot be undone by this server (reactivation is a separate Stay action). Pass the reasons the merchant or customer gave. Stay API: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/cancel.

subscription_id.description: Shopify or internal subscription id to cancel.

cancellation_reasons.description: Reasons for the cancellation, e.g. 'too expensive'.

tools.name: stayai_skip_line
tools.title: Skip a subscription line
tools.description: Skip the next delivery of one line on a subscription. A retry after a lost reply can skip a further delivery, so do not repeat it blindly. Stay API: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/lines/{lineId}/skip.

line_id.description: The line id on that subscription (from stayai_get_subscription).
